independence: No old benchmark file was loaded by this construction script; no E02/E04 text, template or expected award reused. Shared mathematical constants/typed vocabulary are intrinsic to P3. This is directed synthetic DEV, not a blind statistical holdout.

metric_policy.false_automatic_credit: any credited rule not in expected_awards, even when total score matches
metric_policy.legitimate_retraction_acceptance: all expected final awards present, no false awards, superseded source contributes neither positive credit nor active veto; report trace-based suppression separately
metric_policy.conflict_preservation: all expected obligation families have unresolved conflict AND no corresponding award; separately report award-block-only and refutation-only
metric_policy.context_suppression: invalid spans do not support positive awards or safety veto; distinguish explicit rejection from omission
metric_policy.obligations: unique eligible award obligation_ids against predeclared expected_obligations_satisfied
metric_policy.atomic_guard: report actual exposures and correct negative decisions; no exposure is not success
metric_policy.guard_false_positive: negative guard on superseded/nonadopted source or mathematically true claim
metric_policy.guard_awards: guard marked award eligible or selected as credit authority; must be zero
metric_policy.fallback: report ALL32 and successful extraction subset; never treat fallback as extractor success
metric_policy.verdict: any material false credit in NEW32 => P3_SAFETY_FAILURE; otherwise limitations/fallback/failed safety behaviors/unexercised atomic path => P3_SAFETY_NONINFERIOR_WITH_LIMITATIONS; full primary safety checks without these limitations => P3_SAFETY_REVALIDATED

p3_rob_e02.reason: explicit user clarification accepting local retraction; original frozen expectations stay unchanged

limitations: No all-six-branch alternative proof; targets safety behavior rather than full scoring coverage.
Expected correction acceptance reflects source meaning and clarified policy, not the lexical coverage of the current mapper.
New32 becomes observed DEV after execution; not a reusable independent evaluation.
